parts.title: WRITING TASK 1
parts.passage:
The chart and table below show the results of a survey of library users at a university.

Categories of library users

Pie Chart data:

  • Full-time undergraduate: 40%
  • Full-time postgraduate: 25%
  • Part-time postgraduate: 20%
  • Distance learning (all courses): 15%

Library user satisfaction (%)

Very satisfiedFairly satisfiedNot satisfied
Library opening hours65350
Helpfulness of staff9550
Availability of books504010
Availability of journals453520
Reliability of wi-fi483319

questions.instruction:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: WRITING TASK 2
parts.passage:
Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning.

To what extent do you agree with this opinion?

How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom?

questions.instruction:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
Write at least 250 words.
